notes.title: Create the Drops of God: the Ambrosia is live on Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Create the Drops of God: the Ambrosia is finally live on Steam with a free demo to grasp a drop of the juicy game that we will release later this year.

Based on the original manga IP Drops of God, join Blue and Goutte in their adventure in Burgundy, France, where the art of winemaking is elevated to a symphony of flavors and emotions while you Create your Ambrosia, the wine of God.

If you are interested to connect with us and other people from Drops of God community, you can join our community on Discord

[url=https://discord.com/invite/jr3DwU3]Join us on Discord[/url]
